Resolves #19619

A dock Workspace now loads `Neo.main.addon.WindowPosition` into each window it arms, the host's own and every admitted vessel's, through `Neo.currentWorker.getAddon`. A window dragged by its native title bar therefore reports its position whatever the app's `mainThreadAddons` list, and the drop zones under it answer. This was the operator's failed pre-release hand check: in the Fleet Manager, a header-action pop-out dragged over the main app painted nothing. The FM lists no `WindowPosition`, and its vessel runs a separate child app (`childapps/widget`) with its own addon list, so only a per-window load reaches it. The host arms only when its App Worker is a SharedWorker (`Neo.currentWorker.isSharedWorker`), so a dock layout in a single-window app loads nothing and starts no poll. One guide paragraph (`DockLayoutsWindows.md`, Station two) says the engine handles it.

Evidence: L2 (real Chrome, the engine's Neural Link e2e for this exact journey, red then green) → L4 required (the installed Fleet Manager after its engine pin moves and it is rebuilt, re-checked by the operator's hand). Residual: the FM-side re-check, Residual-Owner: #14800.

| AC-2 | Unit › "an admitted vessel loads the addon into its own window before the connection reaches any ownership branch": `getAddon` was asked for `['host-window', 'vessel-window']`, and the vessel armed before `afterTearOutWindowConnect`. |
| AC-3 | Unit › "a dock outside a SharedWorker app loads nothing and starts no poll; inside one, every host arms". Component (hosted CI) `DockGeometryObservation.spec`: in the SharedWorker fixture that does not list the addon, the host loads it and arms both observations, and the manager row follows a resize; the dedicated-worker fixture, which lists it, reads `armed: [false, false], polling: false`. |
| AC-4 | `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsWindows.md`, Station two, a new paragraph. |
| AC-5 | Red-first: the new arms fail on the old optional chain (3 failed before the source change). The e2e control below is red on the old `Workspace.mjs`. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The operator re-scoped it twice. Instead of warning about a missing `neo-config.json` entry, the engine pulls the addon in; and the host gate is the worker's runtime `isSharedWorker` flag, not `Neo.config.useSharedWorkers` or the tear-out flag. A config that asks for SharedWorkers but fell back to a dedicated worker therefore arms nothing.
- The component arm of #18077 ran in a dedicated-worker fixture and asserted arming there, which is exactly what the new gate forbids. It is now two arms: the positive one in a new SharedWorker fixture (`test/playwright/component/apps/dock-popout-shared`, reusing `dock-popout`'s app, without `WindowPosition` in its addons) and a no-poll control in the old fixture. Both fail on `dev`'s `Workspace.mjs` and pass here.
- The unit realm's shared `Neo.currentWorker.getAddon` stub (`test/playwright/setup.mjs`) gained `setConfigs`, which the real proxy has. Two specs that stubbed the old global proxy (`DockWorkspaceFirstProjection`, the Workstation `Workspace.spec`) now stub `getAddon`. Their idempotency check counts loads synchronously instead of sleeping.
- The dock's existing capability gates (`openTearOutVessel`, `canOpenTearOutVessel`) still read `Neo.config.useSharedWorkers`; aligning them is out of scope.

## Test Evidence

**The operator's journey in real Chrome**, `WorkstationNativeTitlebarDragNL` › "a popup moved by its OS titlebar previews the zone under its corner and reintegrates there under dwell". `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` was set, and `apps/workstation/neo-config.json` was edited locally so it no longer lists `WindowPosition` (reverted after):
- on this branch (`55e3aa64e6`): **1 passed**;
- on `dev`'s `Workspace.mjs` (checked out over the branch for the run): **1 failed**, `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'intervalId')` at spec :317, which reads the popup's `WindowPosition` poll. The FM's failure, reproduced.

**No regression with the addon listed** (the Workstation's real config): `WorkstationNativeTitlebarDragNL`, `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL` and `VesselNativeRouteNL`, **8 passed**.

**Built-in browser, the Workstation with the addon unlisted:** after load, the main window's `Neo.main.addon.WindowPosition` is present, with `observeMovement` and `observeResize` true and the poll running. That pane blocks popups, so the vessel half is covered by the e2e above.

**All four builds** (Vega, [6112629553](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/19622#issuecomment-6112629553)): with `WindowPosition` unlisted, `dev` leaves the addon absent in devmode, `dist/development`, `dist/esm` and `dist/production`, while this head loads and arms it in all four, including the production webpack chunk path.

**Unit suite:** 4,907 passed, 2 skipped. In 6 full runs, two single failures came from unrelated specs: `selection/GalleryInternalId` once (15/15 alone with `--repeat-each=5`) and `e2e/browserLifecycleReporter`'s fixed-output-file control once. Neither recurred.

| Build | `dev` `4bf45e51` (control) | this head `55e3aa64` |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/workstation` (dev mode) | absent | loaded · `observeMovement: true` · `observeResize: true` |
| `dist/development` | absent | loaded · both armed |
| `dist/esm` | absent | loaded · both armed |
| `dist/production` | absent | loaded · both armed |

All eight boots: 200, the Workstation rendered, 0 failed requests, 0 page or console errors. The control reproduces the silent no-op of the FM defect in every build, and the fix loads and arms the addon in every build, including the webpack chunk path `dist/production` serves. Not covered: a second window (the vessel path); your real-Chrome receipt covers that journey.
